tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i rim pa rdo rje rin po che'i rgyan phreng zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

rgyal kun mthu stobs rdo rje yis// ma rungs rnam par 'joms pa'i lha// slob dpon tshul bzhengs zhabs pad+mor// btud nas de sgrub thabs zab mo// puṇ+ḍa ri ka'i zil dngar du// legs 'khyil rgyud don sbrang rtsi'i mdzod// don gnyer bh+ra ma ra tshogs rnams// dga' ba'i dpyid du 'di na dbye/ 1$0000210'dir rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa khro bo bco lnga'i dkyil 'khor du sgrub pa chen po'i rim pa la 'jug pa'i tshul cung zad dbye bar bya ste/ dang por slob ma dad pa can gyis slob dpon mtshan nyid dang ldan pa btsal gsol ba btab ste/ des kyang legs par brtags la snod dang ldan na/ sngar bsnyen pa bya/ phyis nye ba'i bsnyen pa zhag bdun nam gsum du bya'o// de nas rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor byed pa'i tshe/ sngon du gza' skar khyim shis pa'i dus su/ bdag nyid bdud rtsi 'khyil bar bskyed/ sa'i dbus su dri thig le bya/ me tog gi tshom bu dgram/ mchod gtor bshams la/1$0000280 na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ ma hā yak+ṣa se na 1$0000210sogs gtsang sbra bya ba nas bzlas pa rdzogs pa'i bar du byas/1$0000280 skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyis// sa dang pha rol phyin pa la// lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur// shākya seng ge skyob pa yis// ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa// de bzhin bdag kyang bdud sde las// rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor bri/ 1$0000210zhes mi bskyod pa'i phyag rgyas rdo rje brdabs pas/1$0000280 sa'i dbus nas sa'i lha mo brtan ma mdzes sdug mtshungs pa med pa rgyan gyis brgyan te 'khor 'bum phrag dang bcas pa lus phyed snang bar 'thon pa la rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis ye shes kyi sa'i lha mo spyan drangs/ dza hūm̐ḥbaṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur pa1$0000210ra bsam nas de la/1$0000280 pra ti bhe ar+ghaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/

ā lo ke /gan+dhe/ nai wid+yā/ shap+ta/ pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ ces mchod/ pra ti bhe na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ uṅga tes+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na ba liṃ ta khā hi/ 1$0000210lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul la/1$0000280 gang yang sa la gnas pa dang*// sa la rgyu ba'i lha klu rnams// mchod dang gtor ma 'di longs la// sems can kun dge don du yang*// byams pa'i sems kyis gnang bar mdzod/ 1$0000210ces blangs pas sa phyogs 'dir ci dga' bar spyod cig ces gnang ba sbyin te gzhi'i bdag po dang bcas te de nyid du mi snang bar gyur// yid ches pa'i sa min na ro lnga bsal/ rin po che lnga la sogs pa bcug ste 'thas par bcags nas stegs bu gru bzhi pa steng me long gi ngos 'dra ba bya'o// der ba byung ngam dri'i byug pa byugs/ me tog bsil ma bkram/1$0000280 1$00002101$0000280na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mañcaṇ+ṭa badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ ma hā yak+ṣa se na pa ta ye/ na mo badz+ra kro dhā ya/ ma hā daṃ ṣ+ṭoṭ+ka ṭa bhai ra wa ra ya/ a si mu pa la dha ra ya/ pa ra shu pā sho hasta ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li kha kha khā hi khā hi/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ bhan+dha bhan+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ gṛ h+ṇa gṛ h+ṇa/ gardza gardza/ s+pho ṭa ya s+pho ṭa ya/ bi s+pho ṭa ya bi s+pho ṭa ya/ sarba bigh+nan bi na ma hā ga na pa ti/ dzi wa ta an+ta ka ra ya swā hā/ 1$0000220zhes bdud rtsi 'khyil ba dang*/1$0000280 oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dho sarba dhārma ཿswa bhā shud+dho ྅haṃ/ 1$0000220chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i sngags kyis sbyangs/ sku gzugs bzhag pa sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sku gzugs kyis bzung ba yin la// bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i bum pa bzhag pa khro bo las thams cad pas bzung ba'o// de ni nub dang po'i cho ga'o// de nas sa bzungs der zhag gi mchod pa yin na bdag nyid gtsang sbra nas bzlas pa'i bar sngar ltar byas/

zhag gis ma chod na sa bzung ba'i rjes nas sta gon kyi bgegs nye bar zhi ba'i cho ga bya ste/1$0000280 rang nyid las kyi khro bor gsal ba'i m dang ṭ las mig gnyis nyi ma dang zla ba/ mig 'bras hum̐ las rdo rje/ rkang mthil gnyis su hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i khro bo'i skur gyur 1$0000220pa la/ sgrub pa'i grogs kyis/1$0000280 mgon po thugs rje 'chang ba po// rig sngags rgyal po dge ba can// gnod pa thams cad zhi ba'i phyir// mgon po khyod kyis byin gyis rlobs/ 1$0000220zhes pa'i sh+lau kas gsol ba btab/1$0000280 rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bdag gis sa phyogs 'dir bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi rgyal po rtsom gyis gang su yang rung ba sa phyogs 'di na gnas pa'i lha dang*/ klu dang*/ lha ma yin dang*/ gnod sbyin dang*/ srin po dang*/ yi dwags dang*/ sha za dang*/ smyo byed dang*/ brjed byed dang*/ 'byung po dang*/ gnon po dang*/ nam mkha' lding dang*/ mi'am ci dang*/ rig pa 'dzin pa la sogs pa rgan po dang*/ rgan mo dang*/ g.yog dang 'khor du bcas pa rnams 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du dengs shig 1$0000220ces pa'i bar spyi dang mthun la/1$0000280 hūm̐ hūm̐ 'gro ba 'dzin pa yis ni zin gyis// hūm̐ hūm̐ gdug pa'i yid can gang yin pha tshad song*// hūm̐ hūm̐ khro bo'i rgyal po sdang mig 'bar ba yis// hūm̐ hūm̐ bsregs nas thal ba bzhin du byas ta re// shar phyogs nas ni char chen 'bab// me phyogs glo bur snang ba byung*// gshin rje 'chi bdag gzugs su byung*// bden bral sems can la 'jigs byed// chu phyogs gshin rje 'brug sgra sgrog /rlung gi phyogs nas 'tshub ma 'byung*// gnod sbyin pho mo byang phyogs gnas// dbang ldan phyogs nas sna tshogs gzugs// steng nas mthu chen lha rnams dang*// 'og nas sa 'gas g.yo byed pa// gang dag mtshan mo rgyu ba yi// bgegs rnams thams cad 'gro bar gyis/

1$0000220zhes brjod cing*/1$0000280 na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mañcaṇ+ṭa badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ ma hā yak+ṣa se na pa ta ye/ na mo badz+ra kro dhā ya/ ma hā daṃ ṣ+ṭoṭ+ka ṭa bhai ra wa ra ya/ a si mu pa la dha ra ya/ pa ra shu pā sho hasta ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li kha kha khā hi khā hi/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ bhan+dha bhan+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ gṛ h+ṇa gṛ h+ṇa/ gardza gardza/ s+pho ṭa ya s+pho ṭa ya/ bi s+pho ṭa ya bi s+pho ṭa ya/ sarba bigh+nan bi na ma hā ga na pa ti/ dzi wa ta an+ta ka ra ya swā hā// 1$0000220zhes bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags ring po'i mthar/1$0000280 /oṃ tad+ya thā/ oṃ tru ṭa tru ṭa 1$0000220nas/1$0000280 saṃ gha ṭa ya 1$0000220ces pa'i bar la 1$0000280gnod byed 'byung po mā ra ya phaṭa// 1$0000220ces btags pa'i sngags 'don zhing thun gyis brab// de nas rdo rje'i 'gros kyis bskor ba lan gsum byas la// 'greng nas thal mo 'tshog mar bzhag la/1$0000280 de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ 1$0000220de nas stang stabs bya ste g.yas brkyang dang g.yon brkyang gis phyogs bzhir ba dang*/ thal mo sbyar te sked pa'i g.yas su bzhag la/ rting pa sprad mig 'thur la bltas la/ rdo rje phur pa sred med kyi bu sa 'og rim pa bdun g.yo bar bya'o// hūm̐ 'brug gi sgra lta bu dang*/ rdo rje gyen du gsor zhing rdo rje'i gar bskor nas legs par blangs pa'i rdo rje 'phen pa dang bsdu bar bya'o// de nas khro bo phyag brnyan spro zhing*/ rdo rje be con dang*/ tho ba dang*/ phur bu dang*/ dbyug pa dang*/ mdung thung dang*/ rtse gsum dang*/ ral gri dang*/ mda' bo che dang*/ 'khor lo dang*/ rdo rje rtse gcig pa dang*/ gtun shing thogs pa'i khro bo bcus bgegs gzhom pa'i g.yas brkyang gis stang stabs bya'o// tshangs pa'i gnas man chad gser gyi gzhi yan chad lha dang lha ma yin dang*// gnod sbyin rnams gcig tu bsdus nas rdo rje me dang rlung gi khro bos bskrad par bya'o// dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su seng ge'i tshul gyis mchongs nas g.yas brkyang dang g.yon brkyang bya ba dang*// rdo rje khu tshur gnyis sked par ha re bzhag nas lus po sgur zhing gar bya ba dang*// rdo rje gsor zhing rkang pa g.yon pa sa la gdab pa dang*// bung ba'i 'phur stangs bya ste rkang pa brlar bzhag la lus po bskor bar ba'o// g.yon pa rdo rje'i khu tshur gyi nang du g.yas pa'i sor mo btsugs pa bton la ral gri shubs nas 'byin pa bzhin du ral gri'i phyag rgyas bgegs bskrad pa dang*/

rkang pa gnyis gshibs la rdo rje spyi bo la bskor zhing 'khor lo 'phang ba'i tshul du bya'o// de nas 1$0000280sarba bid+yāṃ badz+ra badz+ra 1$0000220zhes pa nas 1$0000280su badz+ra ye swā hā1$0000220'i bar/1$0000280 hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje rgya gram hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'phros pas 'og thams cad rdo rje'i sa gzhi steng thams cad rdo rje'i gur dang bla re/ phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i ra ba zlum po la rdo rje mda' drwa bas brgyan pa/ bar mtshams med pa/ cis kyang mi tshugs/ cis kyang mi shigs/ cis kyang mi 'jig pa'i rdo rje'i mkhar me'i phung por 'bar ba/ nam mkha'i khams khyab par 1$0000220bsam mo// seng ldeng ngam lcags gyi phur bu khro bo bcur yud gyis gsal bas shar du/1$0000280 he phul+lu ni ru phul+lu// gṛ h+ṇa kul+lu mi li tsul+lu ku ru kul+lu// badz+ra bi dā ra ṇā ya badz+ra ki li ki lā ya swā hā// 1$0000220nub tu/1$0000280 ka ṭa ka ṭa// ma ṭa ma ṭa// ra ṭa ra ṭa// mo ṭa na pra mo ṭa nā ya badz+ra ki li ki lā ya swā hā// 1$0000220lhor/1$0000280 tsa ra ni tsa ra/ ha ra ha ra/ sa ra sa ra/ mā ra ya/ badz+ra bi dā ra ṇā ya badz+ra ki li ki lā ya swā hā/ 1$0000220byang du/1$0000280 ts+tshin+da ts+tshin+da/ ma hā ki li ki lā ya swā hā// 1$0000220byang shar du/1$0000280 bin+da bin+da/ ma hā ki li ki lā ya swā hā// 1$0000220shar lhor/1$0000280 ban+dha ban+dha/ badz+ra ki li ki lā ya swā hā// 1$0000220lho nub tu/1$0000280 kro dha badz+ra ki li ki lā ya swā hā// 1$0000220nub byang du/1$0000280 tsu ru tsu ru tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra ki li ki lā ya swā hā// 1$0000220steng du/1$0000280 ha ra ha ra badz+ra dha ra yi/ trā sa ya trā sa ya badz+ra ki li ki lā swā hā/ 1$0000220/'og tu/1$0000280 pra ha ra pra ha ra/ badz+ra pra bhan+dza nā ya/ tra sa ya trā sa ya badz+ra ki li ki lā ya swā hā// 1$0000220zhes khro bcu'i nga rgyal dang 'cham stabs su brdab/

gu gul gyis bdug par bya'o// de nas thig btab ste lha gnas ma 'chol bar lha gnas su dri'i thig le byas// me tog gi tshom bu bkod/1$0000280 a mṛ ta1$0000220sa bsangs/1$0000280 /swa bhā wa1$0000220sa sbyangs/1$0000280 /tshom bu mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las// bh+rūṃ las de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i 1$0000220nas/1$0000280 /ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs 1$0000220pa'i bar bsnyen pa bzhin la// de nas 1$0000280oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra bi dā ra ṇa sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ 1$0000220sogs nas/1$0000280 de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dbang bskur bar 'gyur ro// 1$0000220zhes pa'i bar gyis ye shes dgug gzhug bcing mnyes dbang bskur ba rnams byas te/1$0000280 lha mo zla ba ltar dkar gzugs// 1$0000220sogs kyis me tog la sogs pa lngas mchod cing*/1$0000280 rdo rje ri dang 1$0000220sogs kyis bstod par bya'o// lha sta gon no/1$0000280 1$0000220/de nas stegs bu gtsang ma'i khar bum pa gser ram dngul las byas pa bcu gnyis sam lnga/ yang na dbang bskur ba'i dang*/ las thams cad pa'i gcig ste gnyis la rigs kyi mtshan ma bris/ bkru shing phyi/ btsa' ba dang nag nog med pa/ kha gyed pa/ mchu 'phyang ba/ gsus pa che ba/ mgrin pa ring ba/ ras sam dar gyis mgul bcings pa/ 'bras bu can gyi shing lo ma dang bcas pa dang*/ ku sha dang rma bya'i sgro bdun bdun gyis kha brgyan pa'i nang du/ kaṇ+ḍa kā rī/ sle tres/ rgya mtsho'i lbu ba/ chu srin sder mo/ dbang lag ste sman lnga/ 'bras so ba/ sran/ nas/ gro/ til te 'bru lnga/ gser/ dngul/ shel/ byu ru/ mu tig la sogs pa rin po che lnga/ tsan dan dkar po/ ga bur/ gur gum/ dzā ti/ li shi ste sman lnga/ klu gnod na gla rtsi/ gzhan du srogs chags yan lag 'byung mi shis// ces pas// gzhug par mi bya'o// sa'i snying po 'bru mar/

chu'i lan tshwa/ rtsi thog gi mar/ shing thog gi bu ram/ me tog gi snying po sbrang ste snying po lnga/ spos chu dang bcas pa 'am/ shel dang rdo rje pha lam dang me tog sngon po gsum mam/ ma 'byor na gser gcig pus kyang ngo*// de nas bum pa/ 1$0000280amṛ ta1$0000220sa bsangs/1$0000280 swa bhā wa1$0000220sa sbyangs/1$0000280 bum pa mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las gzhal yas khang gi nang du baṃ las rgya mtsho chen po'i dbus su paṃ las pad+ma'i sdong po'i steng du a las byung ba'i zla ba la hūm̐/ gtso bo'i bum pa'i hūm̐ nag po 1$0000220nas/1$0000280 dbus na bzhugs pa steng du hūm̐ mdzad 'og tu stobs po che/ khro bo bzhi'i bum pa'i hūm̐ las shar du 1$0000220nas 1$0000280bskor ba/ khro bo brgyad kyi bum pa'i hūm̐ las 1$0000220nas/1$0000280 bzhugs pa 1$0000220ces pa'i bar dang*/ lnga yin na dbus su gtso bo dang khro bo bcu// gcig las med na 1$0000280zla ba la gnam lcags 'bar ba'i 'khor lo 1$0000220nas/1$0000280 nyi ma la bzhugs pa 1$0000220ces pa'i bar du rigs pas shes par bya'o/1$0000280 /las bum gyi hūm̐ las bdud rtsi'i mtsho'i steng du pad zla la las thams cad pa'i khro bo shin tu 'jigs pa 1$0000220nas 1$0000280bzhugs pa1$0000220'i bar/1$0000280 shu tis+thi ra badz+ra 1$0000220sogs kyis gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/1$0000280 snying ga'i sa bon sogs 1$0000220nas/ 1$0000280bdud rtsi 'khyil la phyag 'tshal bstod 1$0000220bar gyis ye shes pa spyan drangs dgug gzhug dbang bskur mchod bstod kyi bar byas nas// gzungs thag blangs te sngags khro bo'i ngag tu bzlas dus 1$0000280sngags 'phreng gzungs thag la 'khril te bum pa'i lha'i thugs kar thim par 1$0000220bsam/1$0000280 1$0000220gzungs ring tshar gsum dang gzungs thung gang 'grub bzlas/

gzungs thag las bum khar bzhag nas/1$0000280 na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ sogs bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags ring tshar gsum bzla/ mthar lha 'od zhu nas bum pa'i chur gyur 1$0000220par bsam mo// de ni bum pa sta gon no// de nas las dang mthun pa'i phyogs su thab bca' ba nas/ ye shes kyi me lha la sreg blugs 'bul ba'i bar byas nas/ ye shes kyi me lha dkyil 'khor gyi phyir du bzhugs su gsol/ 'jig rten pa'i me lha gshegs// me lha'i dam tshig pa tha mal gyi mer thim par bsam ma mo// de ni sbyin sreg gi sta gon no// de nas slob ma khrus byas me tog thogs/ slob dpon dang lha la phyag 'tshal du bcug nas/ maṇ+ḍal phul te/1$0000280 dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol// byang chub chen po'i tshul ston pa// mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag kyang bzhugs par 'tshal/ 1$0000220zhes gsol ba gdab/ slob dpon gyis/1$0000280 spyod pa ni gsum ste/ bden pa dang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/ gsang sngags kyi spyod pa la brten pa yin no// de'i nang nas mchog tu gyur pa ni gsang sngags kyi spyod pa ste/ 'di ltar/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'das pa dang*// de bzhin gang dag ma byon pa// da ltar byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas// de dag kun gyis gsang sngags kyi// cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen pas// dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du// thams cad mkhyen pa tshad med brnyes// gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med de// skyob pa shākya seng ge yis// bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa'i// dpung chen dag kyang de yis bcom// zhes rgyud las gsungs pas so/ 1$0000220zhes spro ba ba skyed/1$0000280

/rtog pa thams cad legs par bsdus nas ni// shin tu bsam pa bzang po ldan pas nyon// brjed ngas blo la rdo rje 'dzin sogs kyi// bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis byin mi rlobs/ 1$0000220ces nyan par gdams/1$0000280 dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ 1$0000220sogs bdun rnam dag gis byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis bskyed// slob ma bsangs sbyangs/1$0000280 /stong pa'i ngang las bcom ldan 'das khro bo'i rgyal po 1$0000220zhes pa nas 1$0000280dbus na bzhugs pa 1$0000220ces pa'i bar gyis lhar bskyed// rdo rje dang bcas pa'i dri'i chus gnas gsum du 1$0000280hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ 1$0000220ces brjod cing reg pas/1$0000280 /spyi bor oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po// mgrin par āḥlas pad+ma dmar po// snying khar hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon pos mtshan pa// oṃ āḥhūm̐ 1$0000220zhes reg cing byin gyis brlab/1$0000280 /oṃ badz+ra bi dā ra ṇa puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ 1$0000220nas 1$0000280shap+ta1$0000220'i bar gyis mchod// tshom bu lnga bkod pa'i maṇ+ḍal mdun du bkod// a shwa ta la sogs pa'i so shing sor bcu gnyis pa rtse mo me tog gis bcings pa sbyin nas/1$0000280badz+ra ha sa a/ 1$0000220ces pas 'dor du 'jug go/1$0000280 /dbus su mchog /shar zhi ba la sogs pa// mtshams 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub// steng 'og mkhar dang sa la spyod pa'i rig 'dzin du 'gyur ro// 1$0000220de nas dri'i chus/1$0000280 oṃ hrīḥbi shud+dhaḥsarba dha rma sarba pā pā ni tsā s+ya sho dha ya sarba bi kalpan a pa nā ya hūm̐/ 1$0000220khyor bar byin pa hub gsum 'thungs nas lhag ma rgyab tu dor/1$0000280 badz+ra tik+ṣ+ṇa baṃ/ 1$0000220zhes bzlas pa'i ku sha sngas dang gdan du byin/ rtsa ba'i sngags bzlas pa'i srung skud skyes pa'i g.yas dang bud med kyi g.yon du bcing*/1$0000280

/badz+ra rak+ṣa 1$0000220ces rdo rje rgya gram du dri'i chu dang bcas byin gyis brlab/1$0000280 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen rnams// u dum+ba ra'i me tog bzhin// brgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo*// gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba// de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste// gang gis sems can mnyam med don// mya ngan mi 'da' byed par nus/ 1$0000220zhes chos bshad/1$0000280 bzhin bzang dag do nub nyol la rmi lam rtogs shig dang*// sang dkyil 'khor chen po mthong bar 'gyur ro/ 1$0000220ces brjod// de nas sta gon gyi lha la/1$0000280 bcom ldan rdo rje rnam 'joms ni// rig pa'i rgyal por phyag 'tshal bstod// khyed rnams la yang mchod pa dang*// sems can kun la brtse don du// sang ni dkyil 'khor bri bar bya// yo byad ci 'byor gyis bri na// bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la// thugs ni brtse bar dgongs nas su// tshogs pa thams cad dkyil 'khor du// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ 1$0000220zhes snyan gsan phab nas dkyil 'khor gyi khang par bla ma dang slob ma ku sha'i sngas dang gdan la nyal lo// de ni slob ma sta gon te nub gnyis pa'i cho ga'o// des sgrub pa'i yi ge rdzogs so// nang par slob pa'i rmi lam dris// mi shis na spogs pa'i cho ga bya ste slar brtag go// de nas sta gon gyi lha la/1$0000280 lha mo zla ba ltar dkar gzugs/ 1$0000220sogs kyis mchod/ 1$0000280sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs/ 1$0000220sogs kyis bstod pa byas te/1$0000280 badz+ra dṛ ṣ+ṭi ma ṭa/ 1$0000220ces nam mkha' la bteg la bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags zlos shing*/ tshon sna lnga'i srad bu gsar pa gtsang ma mdzes pa/ shin tu ran pa/ dri zhim pa/ reg pa bde ba/ legs par bkal ba sbom phra ran pa/ 'jur mdud med pa phyogs bzhi dbus lngar bkod la/1$0000280
